segments.text: Clean My Mac costs $40 a year, phones home, and pushes upsell prompts. Pure Mac does the same job for free. System caches, Xcode derived data, homebrew
cache, APFS, purgible space, no network calls, source code on GitHub if you want to verify, scheduled auto cleaning builtin. One thing Clean My Mac doesn't
have, purgible space, purging via time machine snapshots. Pure Mac does.
